newsitem.title: UK: Henlys warns on H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Henlys warns on H1 results.

text.p: British vehicle distributor and public service vehicle manufacturer Henlys Group Plc said on Wednesday that first half results would be hit by what it called short-term inefficiencies and changes needed to raise output at its Northern Counties and Prevost businesses.
"We therefore expect the coach and bus division's results to be weighted towards the second half," the copmany said in a statement.
Henlys said it expected to make progress in 1997 and said demand for buses in Britain and for coaches in the U.S. was at its highest level this decade.
"Consequently, we will be increasing production levels throughout the remainder of the year," the company said.
Henlys said its motor division was performing in line with the results achieved in the first quarter and the two Altwood BMW dealerships bought last year were meeting expectations.
Henlys said it would continue its search for acquisitions.
